description: Status and progress of one AI generation job. Poll after hivelearn_generate_ai_course. status is queued | processing | completed | failed | refunded; current_step shows the phase; course_id is the resulting course. A job that stays queued with started_at null was never picked up and is failed and refunded automatically within about an hour. Needs scope read:ai.
name: hivelearn_get_ai_job
